title: Monotonicity of bvVariationOn in the domain
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every function u : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) and all sets W ⊆ O ⊆ ℝⁿ, Chapter02.bvVariationOn u W ≤ Chapter02.bvVariationOn u O in [0,∞]. No openness, measurability or integrability is assumed. Here bvVariationOn u A is Simon's variational quantity (2.4): the supremum of ofReal(∫_A u·div g) over compactly supported Lipschitz vector fields g : C_c(ℝⁿ,ℝⁿ) with tsupport g ⊆ A and compactlySupportedSupNorm g ≤ 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Rn n → ℝ) (W O : Set (Rn n)), W ⊆ O → Chapter02.bvVariationOn u W ≤ Chapter02.bvVariationOn u O
